maintenance_items.description: Use 0W16 synthetic for hybrid. The Atkinson cycle engine operates at different RPM ranges.
Toyota specifies super-long-life coolant. First change at 160k km, then every 80k km.
Hybrid Atkinson engine runs fewer hours per km. Iridium plugs last longer.

maintenance_items.label: Hybrid battery cooling filter
maintenance_items.description: The hybrid battery has a dedicated cooling fan with an intake filter. Clean annually; replace if clogged.
Toyota specifies the same super-long-life coolant for the inverter circuit.
The 2ZR-FXE uses a timing chain. No replacement needed.
